messages:
neha: Quick FYI, saw a ~22% p99 regression on the 8xA100 pipeline job after the new kernel-selection tweak.
omear: Which tweak? the small-warp preference we shipped last Thurs?
neha: Yes — we let the selector prefer tiny-warp kernels for short sequences. Attached an abridged perf sample below.
tim: Drop the perf snippet here please. Even a few lines helps.
neha: ```
2026-03-10T14:03:12Z root: step=120 seq=64 tp=2 pp=4 allreduce=138ms compute=85ms comm_wait=120ms kv_prefetch_misses=18%
2026-03-10T14:03:12Z gpu3: nvlink-util=92% pcie=18% nccl:op=allreduce ring_chunk=1MB
```
lee: nvlink util that high screams link hotspot / shard placement crossing wrong node boundaries.
omar: Also the kv_prefetch_misses 18% is non-trivial. Smaller kernels shorten compute bursts so KV prefetch window may not be priming.
neha: We repro'd on DGX (NVLink mesh) and on our EFA clusters. On PCIe-only machines, absolute allreduce times are worse but relative regression vs baseline is larger on EFA.
tim: Any changes to NCCL env? I recall we set NCCL_LAUNCH_MODE=PARALLEL in the new image.
lee: We toggled NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1 on a subset of nodes last week too.
omar: I'm worried about increased collective frequency: tiny kernels -> more frequent collective starts -> more NCCL startup overhead and smaller effective chunk sizes. That reduces overlap.
neha: Flame graph uploaded to perf dashboard (link below). Main takeaway: kernel selector increased tiny-kernel count, which fragments compute and raises allreduce start rate.
perf-bot: @neha trace trc-20260310-9 added to perf dashboard: https://perf.redwood/traces/trc-20260310-9
tim: Overlap numbers earlier: compute=85ms vs comm_wait=120ms. That suggests poor compute/comm overlap. We need a flame + nccl trace.
lee: Options to consider: revert selector (fast), topology-aware stage placement, group kernel emissions (mini-batching of kernel calls), or hierarchical allreduce (node-local then inter-node).
omar: Quick experiments: bumping microbatch/device from 2->3 reduced allreduce count by ~28% and improved p99 by ~10%, but we squeezed memory.
neha: Repro notes:
- regression happens on both NVLink and EFA, larger on EFA
- KV prefetch misses correlate with smaller microbatches
- NVLink per-link util shows imbalance on some DGX units

lee: Action plan:
- revert kernel-selector in canary and measure delta (owner: tim)
- repro on DGX-14 and collect per-link nvlink counters + NCCL debug (owner: omar)
- run microbatch sweep (2,3,4) to find sweet spot (owner: neha)
- try hierarchical allreduce / NCCL tree vs ring in canary (owner: lee)
- tune KV prefetch window (ms) to increase prefetch priming (owner: neha)

omar: I'll book DGX-14 slot, collect ib/nvlink counters and run nccl-trace.
perf-bot: booking recorded: DGX-14 reserved 2026-03-11 09:00-11:00 UTC by omar
neha: Quick repro tests so far: revert selector -> p99 back within 3% of baseline on NVLink racks. On EFA clusters, revert improves but still ~6% residual gap.
tim: If revert recovers >12% p99 regression we'll roll back selector. If not, proceed with topology-aware placement + hierarchical allreduce as fallback.
lee: Also add a small gating test: microbatch vs kv_prefetch_misses in CI perf harness so future selector changes run this sweep automatically.
neha: I'll post updated perf traces here after omar's DGX run. @tim @omar ping when traces are uploaded :thumbsup:
